claims.quote: Originating in West Asia, it has been worn by a number of cultures around the world for thousands of years.
The caftan appears to be the oldest Turkish dress; this costume can be traced as far back as the Hun and Göktürk periods.
claims.note: said to be oldest Turkish dress

claims.quote: In the recent era the kaftan was introduced to the West in the 1890s, Queen Victoria's granddaughter Alix of Hesse wore a traditional Russian coronation dress before a crowd which included Western on-lookers, this traditional dress featured the loose-fitting Russian kaftan which was so exotic to Western eyes.
claims.note: Russian kaftan shown to the West

claims.quote: According to the Encyclopaedia of Islam, the kaftan was introduced into the Barbary States by the Ottomans and spread by fashion as far as Morocco.
claims.note: Ottomans brought it to the Barbary States

claims.quote: In Southeast Asia, the kaftan was originally worn by Arab traders, as seen in early lithographs and photographs from the region.
claims.note: first worn by Arab traders in Southeast Asia
